item.title: Ethan Klein Spends $10,000 On Billboard Drawing Attention To James Charles' Disturbing Allegations
item.description: The James Charles Allegations Billboard is a billboard in Los Angeles, California meant to draw attention to allegations against beauty influencer James Charles, who admitted to inappropriately texting minors in 2021. The billboard encourages people to search "James Charles Allegations" online and learn more. item.title: Video Of A High Schooler Punching Another Student For Supporting ICE Goes Viral, Inspiring Memes
item.description: High School Kid Punches ICE Supporter or the "Okay" Punch Kid is a viral video of a high school student punching another student, Danny Spud, for holding up a sign supporting the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) during an anti-ICE protest at the school. In the video, the kid announces that he's going to punch Spud, Spud tells him that he's going to get in trouble if he does, and the kid says, "Okay," then throws the punch. Spud posted the video on X / Twitter on February 12th, 2026
